d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how South Africa’s Western Cape High Court has set aside a 2022 independent panel report in its entirety, declaring it unlawful, along with parliamentary steps taken under it after the report had opened a path towards impeaching President Cyril Ramaphosa over the 2020 cash theft at his Phala Phala game farm in Limpopo. The court found the panel misconstrued its remit, exceeded its lawful mandate, and made material errors of law. Ramaphosa’s office said the president will study the judgment, while the African National Congress welcomed the decision.…
